dedupe_keys.name: ov r net begin en eindhaltes visualisatielaag

description: OV - R-net begin- en eindhaltes (visualisatielaag) is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. Deze dataset is een visualisatielaag, passend bij het R-Net openbaar vervoer netwerk. Het bevat de begin- en eindpunten van de lijnverbindingen, om indicatief op de kaart te kunnen visualiseren. Het is dus niet gezegd of deze locaties werkelijk haltes zijn, of de begin- en eindpunten van de lijnverbindingen. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. Its tags are netwerk, openbaar-vervoer, ov, rnet. It offers 4 resource(s) in HTML, PNG, WFS_SRVC, WMS_SRVC. The portal shows 2026-08-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
